dominant_breach: bankruptcy access, discharge scope, exemption floors, and post-discharge record cleanup
fastest_washout: filing cost, nondischargeable debt, exemptions, and post-discharge credit/report tails

fresh_start_capacity_gate.note: Bankruptcy filings are rising, but a fresh start is not certified by filing counts; it requires usable discharge, exemption floors, counsel/fee access, and report cleanup before housing, job, account, or transport thresholds are lost.

bankruptcy_access_and_discharge.note: Legal availability exists, but the proof burden is effective access, discharge scope, and whether low-asset debtors can file and complete relief without losing the recovery floor.

exemption_floor_adequacy.note: Exemption floors must be tested against rent deposits, transportation, bank accounts, tools, phones, and household goods; paper exemptions do not preserve recovery if they require litigation.

exemption_self_execution.note: Non-self-executing exemptions are treated as paper floors because an ordinary debtor may lose assets before asserting protection.

protected_recovery_floor.note: The active case requires a protected-recovery-floor register by state and debt type, not an assumption that discharge alone rebuilds wealth.

proof_debt: bankruptcy access and filing-cost burden by household type
nondischargeable and reaffirmed-debt tails after bankruptcy
post-discharge credit and specialty-report cleanup timing

gate_18_fresh_start_capacity.why: Comfort certification is blocked until the scoreboard proves claim conversion, notice, timing, legal aid or administrative capacity, vendor/report suppression where relevant, and subgroup outcomes at the actual threshold moment.

evidence_debt_register.question: bankruptcy access and filing-cost burden by household type
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Attach filing, fee-waiver, legal-aid, pro se, dismissal, and chapter-conversion data by district and debtor income.

evidence_debt_register.question: nondischargeable and reaffirmed-debt tails after bankruptcy
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Map student loans, domestic support, criminal legal debt, taxes, secured-debt reaffirmation, and repeat distress after discharge.

evidence_debt_register.question: exemption floor adequacy and self-execution
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Score state exemptions against rent, bank account, vehicle, tools, and household survival assets, including whether the protection is automatic.

evidence_debt_register.question: post-discharge credit and specialty-report cleanup timing
evidence_debt_register.next_evidence: Collect credit, tenant, employment-background, bank-account, and insurance-report correction timing after discharge.

remedy_operability_register.claimant_perimeter: Consumer debtors needing discharge and exemption protection
remedy_operability_register.standing_path: Bankruptcy court filing, fee waiver, trustee process, and discharge order
remedy_operability_register.notice_explanation: Notice is formal but not sufficient if debtor lacks counsel, fee access, or language/digital access
remedy_operability_register.interim_protection: Exemptions, automatic stay, and emergency filing must preserve rent, bank, transport, tools, and utilities
remedy_operability_register.time_to_relief: Must arrive before eviction, repossession, bank levy, license loss, or job loss
remedy_operability_register.review_body: Bankruptcy court, trustee, and appellate review
remedy_operability_register.collective_or_representative_action: Legal aid, clinics, U.S. trustee oversight, consumer-enforcement or class/reporting remedies where records remain inaccurate
remedy_operability_register.restoration_remedy: Discharge, stay enforcement, sanctions, exemption return, report correction, and rebuilt access to accounts/housing
remedy_operability_register.enforcement_actor: Bankruptcy courts, trustees, consumer regulators, credit-reporting dispute systems
